title: Edge trace relay with durable local buffering and replay for intermittent connectivity
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement a lightweight OTLP relay designed for edge and intermittently-connected hosts. The relay will accept OTLP/gRPC and HTTP ingest from local services, persist spans to an encrypted disk-backed queue when remote backends (Tempo/Jaeger/OTLP collectors) are unreachable, perform deduplication and watermarking, and replay buffered envelopes with rate-limited, jittered backoff. The component should expose health endpoints and emit local observability metrics (queue depth, disk usage, replay success/failure rates) and integrate with existing tenant routing and auth (per-tenant credentials). Goal: allow offline workers and air-gapped edge instances to ship traces reliably without data loss during short network outages while preserving tenant isolation and SLOs for hosted collectors.
acceptance_criteria: Agent accepts OTLP/gRPC and OTLP/HTTP spans with compatible headers and translates them into internal envelope format
Encrypted disk queue persists at least 24 hours of median peak ingress without dropping spans (configurable retention cap)
Replay pipeline successfully delivers buffered spans to tempo-collector staging and main endpoints with backoff and respect for per-tenant rate limits
Deduplication prevents re-sending of identical spans within a configurable window (default 5 minutes)
E2E test: simulate 15-minute network outage and verify 100% of spans are delivered after connectivity restoration in staging (within replay budget)
Exposes metrics: local_queue_size, disk_queue_bytes, replay_attempts_total, replay_success_total, replay_failure_total, dedup_skipped_total
Security: disk queue encryption integrated with KMS and local key rotation documented
Docs: runbook + troubleshooting steps added to Confluence and Console integration docs linked
tasks: Design disk-backed queue API and on-disk format (compact envelope, index, tombstones)
Implement OTLP ingress adapters (gRPC + HTTP) with backpressure to local queue
Add deduplication index using probabilistic LRU+TTL or small on-disk hash index
Build replay worker with tenant-aware credential rotation and exponential backoff + jitter
Expose Prometheus-style metrics and health endpoints; wire into local diagnostics
Integration test harness: scripted outage + replay verification against tempo staging
Security review: KMS integration and local file permissions audit
Create runbook, Confluence design doc, and example helm/compose configs for edge deployment
